Title: MCP Interface and Tools
Content: MCP server: Orchestrator.Mcp on port 5100 (streamable HTTP /mcp) and stdio. Uses ModelContextProtocol NuGet package (not hand-rolled per D1). 12 operational tools across 5 categories. Phase 0 (7 tools): review_code, refactor_code, generate_tests, search_codebase, apply_patch, run_tests, agent_task. Phase 1 (5 tools): splitbrain_read_file, splitbrain_write_file, splitbrain_list_files, splitbrain_explain_code, splitbrain_query_allowed_root. Each tool validates via FluentValidation where applicable. Idempotency via IIdempotencyCache with atomic TryReserve/TryRemove slot lifecycle (prevents duplicate execution on concurrent retries). Prompt injection sanitization on metadata params. RunTestsTool enforces allowedRoot path scope on every call. WriteAccessGuard with 3 modes (Disabled/PerCallEnable/AlwaysEnabled). Known issues: ReviewCodeTool lacks per-tool timeout (TSK-0036); RunTestsTool hardcodes --no-build (TSK-0037); ApplyPatchTool missing idempotency (TSK-0038); Phase 1 tools return ad-hoc anonymous JSON instead of typed response models (TSK-0045). Backlog: 7 Phase 1 tools + 3 MCP Prompts waiting implementation (TSK-0039 through TSK-0044). Historical bug: RefactorCodeTool had duplicate catch blocks (fixed 2026-06-03).
